description: vampwarrior default look, LIGHT proxy finish (v5; v7 = body6 s11 proxy sha 728b5cea + head6 graft): the colour is the Pixal3D proxy's own texture (sha b8352fbf; face / cape lining touched up by light.recolour3d) baked onto the low (improved/textures/vampwarrior_basecolor.png); proxy_albedo (white) tints it. sword_* regions: the closed procedural sword (light.parts, needs the proposed kit patch; unused by a build without it). No glow.

proxy_albedo.note: tint over the baked proxy albedo (light mode); white keeps the bone-white hair / near-black cape / dark-red lining as baked

sword_blade.note: the bone-pale leaf / flame blade (light.parts sword; brief + sheet chip 177,164,156; SWORD DETAIL pale median 158,144,135)

sword_vein.note: the blade's dark-red centre vein (sheet SWORD DETAIL)

sword_handle.note: the near-black handle (sheet front grip 53,40,41 darkened: orchestrator 'near-black')

sword_ring.note: the silver guard ring + pommel (brief: silver rings)

sword_tassel.note: the red tassel ribbons (light side; sheet tassel red median 81,50,53 / brief 79,49,52 + red)

sword_tassel_dark.note: the tassel ribbons' darker strips (sheet chip 79,49,52)

skin_face.note: the face (light.smooth: smooth-shaded); white = the baked / projected texture as is

hair_head.note: the head hair cap (light.smooth); white = the baked texture

hair_front.note: the front hair strands (light.smooth); white = the baked texture

boot.note: the v5.2 flat boot feet (light.parts): near-black boot leather (sheet chip 33,28,28 / boots 44,38,40)

hair_back.note: v7: the long back hair (light.smooth); white = the baked texture
